# telnyx_compute_function_log_export (Resource)

Where a compute function's logs are exported to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_compute_function_log_export" "example" {
  function_id               = "fn-123"
  endpoint                  = "https://logs.example.com/ingest"
  headers                   = jsonencode({ Authorization = "Bearer ${var.log_token}" })
  runtime_export_enabled    = true
  invocation_export_enabled = true
}

variable "log_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) HTTPS OTLP endpoint URL logs are pushed to
- `function_id` (String) The function id.
- `headers` (String, Sensitive) Headers attached to every export push, as key-value pairs (e.g. an auth token the collector expects). Required even when empty — {} means "no headers". Encrypted at rest; never returned. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `invocation_export_enabled` (Boolean) Whether invocation records (one per HTTP request) are exported
- `runtime_export_enabled` (Boolean) Whether runtime logs (function stdout/stderr) are exported

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether export is enabled for this function
- `func_id` (String) Function ID this configuration belongs to
- `id` (String) Configuration record ID
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_compute_function_log_export.example <function_id>
```
